finding: SumAsync general path alone still await-foreaches ToSequenceAsync. Resolution forwards without effects;PyIteration creates AsyncSequence and AsyncEnumerator wrapping the existing Cursor. Their pulls await/forward cursor results;Any/All already use that Cursor directly. This is a concrete remaining consumer,not a blanket iterator rewrite.
workload: Catalog comprehensions.helper-call and helper-list end with sum(values),using list numeric inputs. File-manifest scripts sum exact bytes and are unchanged controls. This does not establish complete-job performance importance.
proposal: Replace only SumAsync general await-foreach with Cursor.CreateAsync plus await-using/TryMoveNextAsync. Keep ValidateSumStart before cursor acquisition,exact-bytes shortcut,addition dispatch and await,accumulator,span/context and all sync/common iteration sources unchanged. Remove two wrapper objects and per-pull forwarding for this consumer;no new cursor or owner.
acceptance: One predeclared native pair with empty/65 item list/tuple,range,generator and custom addition,alongside sync/exact-bytes controls. Require affected allocation reduction,exact numeric/result identity,fuel/error/span and denial before mutation. Preserve suspended __iter__/__add__/__radd__,nested sum/current accumulator/live aliases and native cleanup once/funded on exhaustion,pull/add fault,cancel,admission or cleanup failure. Reuse existing NativeAggregateState/BytesSum and cancellation coverage,adding only a missing focused external witness.58 complete jobs,one short comparison,no new broad measurement.
stopping: Only general SumAsync. Leave Any/All,sync Sum,bytes shortcut,Cursor,ToSequence and other consumers untouched. No scalar/numeric semantics or generator ownership redesign,retiming,dispatcher/cache/owner. Reject if core cursor/lifetime infrastructure must change.
